subject: Audit gap coverage statement request — Orchid Health
messages:
From: Evan Parker <security@orchidhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Orchid Health Security Team <security@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: interim assurance for post-report period

Hi Irene,

We are in the final stages of onboarding Redwood for a production integration. Our procurement and security teams require an interim assurance statement (sometimes called a bridge or post-period coverage note) that covers the gap between the end date on Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report (2025-10-31) and today.

Specifically, can you provide a short signed statement on Redwood letterhead that:
- Confirms the SOC 2 report scope (systems, services) covered Orchid's intended use or lists material scope changes,
- Covers the period from 2025-11-01 through 2026-06-30 (inclusive),
- States whether there are any known control exceptions, changes to control ownership, or changes in outsourcing/subservice providers that would materially affect Orchid,
- Includes the report date and name of the audit firm (we will attach the SOC 2 we have on file for reference).

Deadline: we need a draft by COB 2026-06-18 and a signed/dated letter by COB 2026-06-20 if possible.

I have attached our SIG reference (Orchid_SIG_reference.xlsx) showing the fields this will feed into. If you prefer, we also accept a DocuSign envelope for signing.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that's easier.

Regards,
Evan Parker
Security Manager, Orchid Health
security@orchidhealth.com

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: interim assurance for post-report period

Hi Evan — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Soojin (Head of Security) and Marcus (Legal) so we can get the right signoff and wording. A few clarifying questions to make sure the attestation meets Orchid's procurement needs:

1) Format: do you need a formally signed PDF on Redwood letterhead, or is an emailed attestation acceptable? You mentioned DocuSign; we can do either.
2) Scope: does Orchid require us to explicitly name the services (Redwood API / Dedicated pools / Private deployment) in the letter, or is a standard SOC 2 bridge statement referencing the SOC 2 scope sufficient?
3) Controls: do you need detailed control-level assertions (e.g., key rotation cadence, encryption at rest) or a high-level statement indicating whether there are any known exceptions/changes?

Tentatively our timeline would be: draft by 2026-06-18, legal review and signature 06-19, final signed PDF via DocuSign by 06-20. If you can confirm preferred format and any mandatory wording, we'll incorporate it.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai

Hi Evan — attaching our draft bridge statement (Redwood_Bridge_Statement_20260617_draft.pdf) and the SOC 2 report for reference (Redwood_SOC2_Type_II_20251031.pdf).

Summary of the draft wording we provided:
- Confirms that the SOC 2 Type II report issued on 2025-10-31 by Meridian Audit LLP covers the services listed in the report and that there are no known control exceptions that would materially affect Orchid Health's use of the Redwood service between 2025-11-01 and 2026-06-30.
- Notes a non-material expansion of regional availability (eu-west-1 added for Dedicated capacity in Feb 2026) which is within Redwood's stated deployment model and does not change the control scope for hosted services used by Orchid.
- Confirms encryption at rest remains enabled for customer data and that key management is performed using a KMS backed by a managed HSM; no provider changes affecting production customer data were made during the period.

Next steps: Marcus will run a legal review of the draft; please flag any specific language you require (you mentioned a line about encryption provider). We can send a DocuSign envelope for signature once Hydra (legal) signs off.

Attachment: Redwood_Bridge_Statement_20260617_draft.pdf
